newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Nat'l Rail yr net profit A$1 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Nat'l Rail yr net profit A$1 mln.

text.p: Government-owned National Rail Corp posted a net profit of A$1.01 million for the year to June 30, according to its annual report released on Thursday.
The result, struck on a rise in sales to A$538.73 million from A$497.05 million previously, compared with a net profit of A$14.87 million in the previous year.
The report said the result was in line with budget.
"The 1995/96 profit was achieved in an environment of a slow economy and growing competition," chairman Ted Butcher said in the report.
"This result was only achieved by the very tight management of costs," Butcher said. He said the sluggish economic conditions hampered revenue growth.
Road competition on the east coast of Australia and the start-up of on-rail competition between Melbourne and Perth also had an adverse impact on revenue, he said.
Butcher called on the government to amend the shareholder agreement, under which National Rail was established in 1993, to enable the company to compete in the intrastate business market.
"The company is being seriously disadvantaged by not having the flexibility to compete in intrastate rail markets," he said.
